title: THOMAS. - Half-Way
htmlContent:
THOMAS.'s "Half-Way"  is a rap record that runs it all the way up. The supreme rap skills from him deserve all the attention and praise garnered, with him providing a superb performance over this exciting instrumental that helped showcase his high skill level in audio form. Greatness is in stored for this amazing artist.

The production is hard and exhilarating while THOMAS. provides all the excitement in the world, with his infectious flow that engages you from the second he opens his mouth till the track ends. The lyrics are swagger filled and have that bravado or machismo you look for in Hip Hop music.
